source_text: bóc-weorc, es; n. Literary work, study :-- Bisceopes dægweorc, þ-bar; bið mid rihte his gebedu ǽrest, and ðonne his bócweorc, rǽding oððon rihting, lár oððon leornung, Ll. Th. ii. 314, 19.
